blurb: Guests can book yacht charters for various occasions such as romantic sunsets, birthdays, corporate events, or relaxing days on the lake. The Island Princess offers scenic cruises to Gibraltar Point and special event cruises like the Toronto Air Show experience. The company operates licensed boats with a focus on safety and customer satisfaction.
extraNote: Bar minimum $25 per person for small groups · No outside alcohol permitted for groups of 50 or more · HTO Park West, Toronto Harbourfront · All summer long for Friday night party cruises

quotes.author: Gabriela Queudo
quotes.text: We booked sunset cruise for our anniversary, and it was absolutely perfect. The yacht was spotless, the views were breathtaking, and the crew was so welcoming. We’ll cherish this forever!

quotes.author: Ronald Johan
quotes.text: We hosted our team appreciation event with Toronto Breeze, and it was a total hit. Professional service, smooth sailing, and the skyline backdrop made for a truly memorable experience.

quotes.author: Sasha Missau
quotes.text: The party package exceeded all expectations. The team handled everything from the music to the decorations, and the bride-to-be was blown away. It was the highlight of our weekend!

quotes.author: Gracie Andra
quotes.text: Booked for my husband's surprise birthday, and it couldn't have gone better. The crew even helped set up a cake and decorations. He was speechless when he stepped on board!
